## Priority
**Nice-to-Have #7** - Lower priority, implement after must-haves

## Description
Implement A/B testing framework to optimize conversion rates and user experience through data-driven experiments.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A/B testing framework implemented
- [ ] Conversion events tracked
- [ ] Statistical significance calculated
- [ ] Easy experiment setup and monitoring
- [ ] Multiple variants supported

## Implementation Ideas
- Use Google Optimize, Optimizely, or custom solution
- Track key conversion events (signup, subscription, feature usage)
- Implement server-side or client-side testing
- Run experiments on: CTA copy, pricing, onboarding flow, etc.

## Experiments to Consider
1. Landing page headline variants
2. CTA button text and colors
3. Pricing page layout
4. Signup flow variations
5. Feature discovery improvements

## Key Metrics to Track
- Signup conversion rate
- Free-to-paid conversion
- Feature adoption rate
- User retention
- Time to first value

## Tools to Consider
- Google Optimize (free)
- Optimizely
- VWO
- Custom with analytics events

- [Google Optimize](https://optimize.google.com/)
